t: This is the Euston Palace of Varieties, a former theatre and cinema in St Pancras, in Camden. It was designed by Bertie Crewe, whose full name was William Robert Crewe. He was one of the leading English theatre architects during the boom years between 1885 and 1915, so this building belongs to that great burst of theatre construction. Today it no longer works as a music hall, but you are standing at a place shaped by one of the busiest theatre designers of his time.
